Analysis.object: Perfectionism in athletes is linked to higher stress, eating disturbances, and body perception issues, with women showing higher stress, emotional eating, and restrictive eating behaviors. Emotional states significantly influence eating patterns, highlighting the need for psychological and nutritional support in sports contexts

Findings are partly inconsistent with previous studies (e.g., gender differences), and results may depend on specific sports or samples. The study also relies on self-reported measures, which may introduce bias

Future research should further explore emotional eating across different sports and genders, and develop targeted interventions. Integrating psychological support, education, and nutritional guidance could help improve athletes’ well-being and performance

Population.object: Athletes between the ages of 13-23 who volunteered to participate
